summary: Okanogan NF site of a 1930 log cabin with cupola on Granite Mountain; cabin removed or destroyed in 1954; hiking trail to the site.

facts.status_note: Cabin removed or destroyed in 1954; remains taken away in 1973; no source found describes what remains at the summit now

access.note: A Forest Service trail runs all the way to the old site; no closure appears in the sources read

visit.trail_note: About 5.5 miles one way from a trailhead off Forest Service roads southwest of Conconully; fire hit the upper trail and deadfall was cut in 2019

events.note: Panorama photographs taken from the cabin, 17 feet above ground
Register says removed; firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say destroyed
USGS party visited the summit and did not report a lookout building
Forest Helitack crew removed the remains of the old lookout and built a helispot

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the cabin was removed in 1954; firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say destroyed that year. A 1973 newspaper item says remains were still on the summit and were then removed, so the story reports the 1954 loss as removal or destruction.

notes_for_editor: Brief record is accurate (elevation 2245.2 m matches 7,366 ft; FFLOS registration date confirmed). Staffing not found in any source read, so no staffing fact. Searches also return an Idaho Granite Mountain and a Snoqualmie Granite Mountain lookout; neither is used. Sources: 2025 WTA trip report is the newest; WillhiteWeb visit was spring 2020. No source describes remains at the summit today.
